Killeen, TX 76542

Charming 3-Bedroom, 2-Bath Home in Killeen! Built in 2008, this beautifully maintained 1,840 sq ft home offers a spacious and inviting floor plan perfect for modern living. With three generous bedrooms and two full baths, the home features a bright, open living space, a well-appointed kitchen, and a cozy dining area ideal for family gatherings. The large backyard provides plenty of room for outdoor entertaining, and the quiet, established neighborhood adds to the charm. Conveniently located near schools, shopping, and local amenities—this is the great place to call home! Don’t miss out!
